full_judgment:
Mohammad Anwarul Haque J.:- This criminal petition for leave to appeal is directed against the judgment and order passed by the High Court Division in Criminal Misc. Case No. 13707 of 2008 passed on 15.07.2010 where the High Court Division has discharged the Rule for quashment of the criminal proceeding issued under section 561A of the Code of Criminal Procedure since concerned court below got no jurisdiction to try the case because offence alleged to have been committed at United Kingdom. Moreover, FIR also does not disclose the offence punishable under section 11(ga) 30 of the Nari-O-Shishu Nirjatan Daman Ain, 2000 (as amended in 2003). 

 2. In short. the case of the prosecution for the purpose of disposal of the Rule is that the victim was married to one Jamal Shah who used to assault the victim for the purpose of realization of dowry; as such a case under section 11(ga)/30 of the Nari-O-Shishu Nirjatan Daman Ain, 2000 (as amended in 2003) was recorded to secure the trial of the husband Jamal Shah and other accused-persons.
